race.description: Sportsbet Fixed Odds Exotics Mdn Plate
race.comment: RESOLUTELY (11) brings the best form. She was good first up over this trip at Flemington before just being pipped on the post at Caulfield by Doubt Time who looks a nice horse. Williams sticks and this circuit should suit her on-speed pattern. Takes catching. She beat home GHANA'S AKAN (6) at Caulfield fairly comfortably. GHANA'S AKAN was first up there and raced wide but that's no disadvantage at Caulfield. She does meet RESOLUTELY a bit better at the weights and 1200m should suit better. SAINTLY DANCER (12) ran well on debut at Geelong when firmly in the market, missing a nose after showing speed. She'll come on from that and take beating. STIPULATION (14) is a filly by Frankel on debut for the Maher yard who has won a jumpout leading in, watch the betting. FIERY FUN (5) is a Rubick filly for the Freedman yard who warrants respect.
